notes: Single-column monospace spec text, so the true order is simply top to bottom. Its value as a case is negative: the running header (0,1,2) and footer (49,50,51) place text at x=150/557/960, which is exactly the shape of three columns. MIN_COLUMN_HEIGHT_RATIO is what stops a cut here — a gutter has to be a channel running down the block, and these are two isolated rows. Regression guard for that threshold.
